review_independence: Fresh context; same-family provisional. Not cross-model independent confirmation.
immutable_anchor: Develop the original Variational Garrote SAE as an alternative to L1 sparsification, evaluating true feature recovery and wrong-sparsity sensitivity. Diagnostics support method development and do not replace the research goal.
decision: Select exactly3 routes: S01 direct method comparison, S02 minimal learned global prior, and S06 joint-support mechanism pilot. Allocate one high-upside slot to S06. Preserve all20 raw variants in13 families; no scientific-quality deletion or paper-kill based solely on nearby prior art.
ranking_policy: Order is qualitative expected information plus scientific upside under this budget; component1–5 scores expose judgment and are not measured evidence or a weighted numerical ranking. Diversify the three questions; do not choose three easy variations of the same diagnosis.

ranking.title: Original VG feature-identity comparison
ranking.strongest_case_for: 현재 VG가 L1 대안으로 실제 dictionary/support 복원에 주는 가치와 강한 non-L1 baseline 대비 위치를 가장 직접적으로 판별한다. 기존 코드 재사용성이 높다.
ranking.strongest_objection: L1 대비 coefficient bias 개선은 이미 알려진 selection/amplitude 분리로 설명될 수 있고 full VG에는 unit-D tangent 방향의 직접 variance 반혼합 힘이 없다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Native L0를 맞추면 이득이 사라지거나 Gated/Anthropic Jump가 같은 회복을 더 잘 달성한다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: 이 경우 VG 자체를 폐기하지 않고 어느 component/학습 경로가 필요한지 P2/P3로 한정한다.

ranking.title: Joint/block support posterior
ranking.strongest_case_for: 32개 support를 정확히 열거하는 작은 실험으로 mean-field 표현력 한계와 단순 amortization gap을 분리할 수 있다. 양성이면 block posterior를 설계할 구체적 근거가 생긴다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Orthogonal D와 independent prior에서는 exact conditional posterior도 factorize한다. 더 풍부한 posterior가 mixed dictionary를 더 잘 설명할 가능성이 있다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Exact joint가 수렴한 mean-field보다 identity를 개선하지 못하거나 one-pass head에만 이긴다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: 확장 가능한 block/amortized 구현은 dictionary 이득, density-matched 결과, 비용이 확인된 후에만 후속 연구로 둔다.

ranking.title: Learned global normalized support prior
ranking.strongest_case_for: 추가 head 없이 scalar gamma만 적응시켜 unknown-L0와 density transfer의 핵심 문제를 직접 시험한다. 성공/실패 원인이 추적 가능하다.
ranking.strongest_objection: pi=mean(m)는 잘못된 dictionary에서도 성립하는 자기 일관성이다. Learned gamma의 scale, 초기화, precision coupling은 남는다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: 초기 gamma에 따라 다른 mixed/dense/collapsed 해에 정착하거나 낮은 loss와 달리 true support를 놓친다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: 실패를 gamma gradient 구현 실패와 과학적 자기확증 실패로 나눠 기록한다. 바로 feature별/graph prior를 추가하지 않는다.

ranking.title: Sparsity continuation
ranking.strongest_case_for: 최종 objective를 유지하며 초기 omission의 영향을 바꾸는 가장 저렴한 training intervention이다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Sparse but Wrong 자체가 continuation을 다루고, 최종 objective가 잘못되면 안정적 해법이 아니라 mixing의 지연일 수 있다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: 공통 final-objective tail 또는 matched L0에서 이득이 사라진다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P1 trajectory에서 초기 recovery 후 악화가 반복되거나 P3가 계산 상한에 막힐 때 다음 사전등록 후보로 승격한다. 근접 선행만으로 제외하지 않는다.

ranking.title: Residual support teacher amortization
ranking.strongest_case_for: Residual-evidence teacher를 train-time으로 옮기면 one-pass native inference를 유지하면서 amortization 문제를 고칠 수 있다.
ranking.strongest_objection: 현재 evidence로는 objective 자체가 맞는지 불분명하다. 잘못된 optimum의 teacher를 잘 흉내 낼 수 있다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Fixed-D support만 좋아지고 learned-D identity는 개선되지 않거나 generic amplitude/extra-compute control로 설명된다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P3에서 converged MF가 현재 amortized head보다 좋고 exact joint의 추가 이득은 작을 때 우선한다.

ranking.title: Precision-timescale control
ranking.strongest_case_for: Minibatch precision과 active-count 변동이 만든 불안정을 싸게 분리할 수 있다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Global versus profiled objective는 동일하지 않고, 낮은 beta variance만으로 feature identity를 설명하지 못한다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: 큰 batch나 안정된 beta에서도 mixing은 그대로이며 recovery 차이가 없다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P1/P2 로그에서 beta floor, 큰 count-beta 상관, 반복적인 collapse가 보일 때 먼저 수행한다. 단순 hygiene를 새 주요 기여로 부풀리지 않는다.

ranking.title: Correlated support prior
ranking.strongest_case_for: Wrong dictionary가 coactivation을 대신 설명한다는 가설을 support prior 수준에서 바꾸는 직접 방법 후보다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Wrong gate에서 추정한 pairwise prior도 자기확증적이며 posterior와 prior를 동시에 바꾸면 원인이 분리되지 않는다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Learned W가 같은 혼합을 합리화하거나 attained L0 보정 후 이득이 없다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P3 exact-independent posterior가 충분한데 prior mismatch가 남는 증거가 생길 때 선택한다. Tiny exact partition만으로 확장 가능성을 주장하지 않는다.

ranking.title: Amplitude stationarity training
ranking.strongest_case_for: L1 없는 VG에서도 남는 amplitude stationarity 문제를 겨냥하며 broad-amplitude 후속에 유용하다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Generic rescaling/refitting으로 거의 설명될 가능성이 높고 identity 문제와 분리해야 한다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: MSE/계수 오차만 개선되고 signed dictionary/support 회복은 그대로다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P1의 calibration-only L1 rescaling 및 coefficient error가 유력 병목을 보일 때 선택한다.

ranking.title: Feature-frequency prior with shared shrinkage
ranking.strongest_case_for: 희귀 feature와 불균등 firing에 맞춘 prior는 global scalar의 확장으로 해석하기 쉽다.
ranking.strongest_objection: 이번 첫 toy의 marginal p는 동일하다. 아직 찾지 못한 feature의 낮은 posterior count를 prior가 더 억제할 수 있다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Rare recall이 떨어지거나 빈도 증가로만 이득을 얻는다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: S02의 global adaptation 가능성을 확인하고, unequal-frequency 평가를 사전등록한 뒤 수행한다.

ranking.title: Cross-seed stability selector
ranking.strongest_case_for: True labels 없이 operating point를 고르는 구체적 wrapper이며 현재 체크포인트를 재사용할 수 있다.
ranking.strongest_objection: 동일 wrong dictionary의 재현성도 높을 수 있다. 여러 replica는 현재 3개 파일럿의 자원을 분산한다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Stability가 dead/common/mixed atom만 선호하거나 c_dec보다 oracle regret가 크다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P1에서 넓고 실제로 좋은 VG operating region이 있고 단일 unlabeled selector만 실패할 때 선택한다.

ranking.title: Explicit slab uncertainty
ranking.strongest_case_for: 명시적 amplitude uncertainty는 weak activation과 absence의 혼동에 구조적 해법을 줄 수 있다.
ranking.strongest_objection: 모델 변화와 slab hyperparameter가 크며 VSC/VAEase에 더 가까워진다. 현 narrow-normal toy만으로 판단하기 어렵다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Slab KL이 amplitude bias를 재도입하거나 coefficient uncertainty만 좋아지고 identity는 그대로다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: Point amplitude 보상관계가 P2 실패 원인이고 broad-amplitude shift에서 재현될 때 별도 완전한 likelihood/prior 유도와 함께 수행한다.

ranking.title: Hard-code decoder training
ranking.strongest_case_for: Mean-versus-hard deployment mismatch가 dictionary 학습에 미치는 영향을 직접 바꾼다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Hard omission은 Sparse but Wrong 압력을 오히려 키울 수 있으며 block objective가 달라진다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: Mixing/oscillation이 커지거나 더 많은 optimizer work가 전부 설명한다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P1에서 큰 mean-hard gap과 gate uncertainty가 동시 반복되고 그 gap이 recovery 실패에 선행할 때만 선택한다.

ranking.title: Gate-uncertainty prior selector
ranking.strongest_case_for: VG entropy/sensitivity를 이용해 sweep 내 선택 비용을 낮출 수 있다.
ranking.strongest_objection: Confident wrong mixing이 가능하며 임의 entropy/transition threshold가 oracle tuning을 숨길 위험이 있다.
ranking.most_informative_failure: 전이가 mixed/dead 상태를 가리키거나 sweep 방향과 source threshold에 민감하다.
ranking.defer_or_followup_condition: P1 sweep에 truth-free로 반복되는 전이가 있는지 탐색 기록만 남긴다. 테스트 결과를 본 뒤 selector 규칙을 만들지 않는다.

dataset.dictionary: QR-orthonormal, different fixed world dictionary per paired seed; shared across methods and splits within world
dataset.support: Gaussian copula hub; latent C_0j=C_j0=rho, all other off-diagonal 0; measure realized Bernoulli support correlation separately
dataset.amplitude: max(0, Normal(1, .15)) primary; RMS-matched exponential preserved for a preregistered later transfer, not added after seeing primary test results
dataset.finite_data_note: Minibatch sampling with replacement from finite train set. This is paper-inspired screening; original code uses online fresh examples and 15M samples. QR is also a deliberate difference from original optimized orthogonalization.

seeds.condition_index: Within one world, density/correlation arms share the same underlying RNG seeds for common-random-number pairing; split seeds remain independent. Actual tensors differ by rho/p; save hashes. P2 p=.4 +/- .4 uses exact P1 tensors/checkpoints. No condition-index offset in this authoritative root contract.

optimization.precision: float32; deterministic numerical checks in float64
optimization.normalization: Unit decoder columns after each optimizer step and remove radial decoder gradient consistently; common unnormalized x (no per-input norm). If baseline trainer normalization is unavoidable, use one common train-fitted scalar for all methods and unscale evaluation; log the change before runs.
optimization.bias: Trainable decoder bias initialized to0 for all comparable arms; VG pre_bias=0 and gate_bias_init=-2 explicitly. Architecture-specific remaining defaults are logged. This matches the root/P1 launch contract.
optimization.fairness: Share D initialization wherever API permits, training indices, examples, updates and checkpoint opportunities. Architecture-specific optimizer/loss schedules must be explicit. Do not compare core AdamW VG to Adam baselines accidentally.

readout.vg: a(x) * 1[m(x) > .5]; never tune threshold on test
readout.l1: raw native ReLU, exact positive values counted; no train-GMM threshold in primary
readout.anthropic_jumprelu: native learned threshold at inference; training MUST explicitly select tanh sparsity plus documented pre-act/STE variant. Project default step-loss JumpReLU is a different optional baseline, not a replacement.
readout.batchtopk: native exported inference threshold learned/estimated by its training recipe. Do not use batch TopK at evaluation. k is a batch mean budget, not the true count of every sample.
readout.p3_exact_joint: joint MAP state (argmin state energy, ascending binary-index tie-break) times a; also report common marginal >.5 readout as a separate prespecified control.

metrics.matching: Signed Hungarian one-to-one mapping using learned D and D_star; freeze per checkpoint before support evaluation. No sign flips for positive codes. Absolute matching is secondary. Helper needs macro/per-feature F1 and logging extensions; four helper tests were reported by the root, not rerun by this jury.

selection.freeze: Write protocol/config/seeds, dataset hashes, checkpoint IDs, calibration metrics and chosen IDs to selection_manifest.json BEFORE loading test tensors/evaluating any test metrics. All grids and checkpoints retained; do not silently discard failed models.
selection.primary_checkpoint: Final common step. Intermediate checkpoints only for prespecified oracle-cal and trajectory reports, with equal candidate counts; never training-loss-best as cross-method quality selection.
selection.matched_l0: At each target 1.8,2.0,2.2 choose final-step control minimizing abs(calibration native hard L0 - target), tie by lower calibration hard MSE, then ascending control index. Require target distance <=.15 and compared method-pair L0 difference <=.10; otherwise label unmatched and do not assert matched-L0 advantage. Targets use known synthetic mean L0 only for a diagnostic comparison; not a deployment rule.
selection.oracle_cal: Separate ceiling: among candidate checkpoints and controls satisfying target tolerance choose maximum signed cosine, tie lower mixing, then higher support F1, then later checkpoint and ascending control index. Clearly labeled ground-truth-assisted and never called automatic unknown-L0 selection.
selection.truth_free: Report native fixed recipe/final checkpoint as main transfer arm; optional c_dec-min selector across final controls, ties calibration hard MSE then control index. c_dec choice is a fallible comparator, never truth.
selection.rescaled_l1: Fit one positive scalar per nondead latent on calibration x to minimize reconstruction with support and decoder direction fixed (bounded nonnegative LS); freeze coefficients, then evaluate test. Treat dead/zero-scale case explicitly and preserve original support for support metrics. Report as coefficient-bias control, not an additional dictionary method.

decision_thresholds.unit: Paired training worlds, not individual test examples, are replication units; n=3 is screening only. Show all seed outcomes and paired differences, no decisive significance claim.
decision_thresholds.pilot_worth_following: At matched L0, at least 2/3 worlds for EACH rho sign satisfy signed-cosine improvement >=.05 OR recovered-fraction improvement >=.20, plus support F1 improvement >=.03 and mixing-energy reduction >=.01. Compare VG to L1 and separately each strong baseline; do not choose the winning comparator after test.
decision_thresholds.strong_baseline_interpretation: VG-versus-L1 only supports an L1-alternative result. Gated/Anthropic Jump/BatchTopK parity or dominance rules out a broad superiority claim but does not invalidate continued VG method development.
decision_thresholds.broad_wrong_sparsity: Requires the prespecified joint criterion at BOTH wrong-L0 targets 1.8 and 2.2, both correlation signs; a peak near 2.0 or a post-test selected region is insufficient.
decision_thresholds.fidelity_tradeoff: Hard EV drop >.02 versus comparator is reported as feature-fidelity tradeoff even if recovery thresholds pass; do not describe it as overall dominance.
underpowered_or_unresolved: Fewer than three paired training worlds completed
No method at correct region reaches mean signed cosine >=.90 and F1 >=.80; known-D control or longer convergence check missing
L0 grids fail tolerance or native-code budget is unmatchable
Training loss still improves >5% relative from step1500 to3000 with nonstationary recovery; no stability/convergence evidence
Variant recipe absent (e.g. default step Jump used in place of Anthropic tanh/pre-act)
Precision floor/clamp or numerical error dominates
MF solver fails convergence in P3; cannot treat a solver failure as evidence for covariance benefit
decision_thresholds.negative: A mechanism is unsupported only in this finite tested regime when implementation checks, controls and coverage succeed and the stated effect is absent. Missing convergence or coverage is not an idea-kill.

budget.gpu0: Never touch; occupied by unrelated work
budget.devices: Recheck physical1/2/3 immediately before launch. Record CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to physical-device map.
budget.estimates_are: Ex ante planning estimates, not measured promises. Include scouts, restarts, failed jobs and solver steps in consumed GPUh.
budget.runtime_probe: Time 100 optimizer updates for the most expensive arm at intended batch size before full grid. If forecast exceeds cap, retain 3 worlds and final step at minimum2000; uniformly reduce controls or mixed-init secondary arms before any test access, version and freeze manifest. Do not run a cap-breaking job or keep easiest seeds only.
budget.schedule: After numerical gates and runtime probe, independent P1/P2/P3 training may proceed on physical1/2/3 with shared read-only data. P2/P3 do not require seeing P1 test results.

selected_pilots.title: Current VG versus L1 and strong non-L1 methods under wrong sparsity
selected_pilots.question: Does existing VG learn more faithful features, beyond shrinkage mitigation and density changes?

training.vg_beta: Current profiled policy, entropy_weight=1, variance on; log beta/floor
training.jump_recipe: bandwidth=2, initial threshold=.1, tanh sparsity, pre-act recipe enabled/documented; scale l0 warmup to first1000 of3000 updates and record this shortened pilot deviation. BatchTopK constant k, no k schedule.

bounded_scout.conditions: One separate scout world id99, rho0,p.4; 1000 updates, cal L0 only; no truth-based recovery inspection
bounded_scout.rule: Start with the listed5 controls/method. If an endpoint fails to bracket [1.5,2.5], add at most2 endpoint controls: VG low=-6/high=10; positive coefficients low=initial min/10 and high=initial max*10. BatchTopK unchanged. Freeze5 controls as ordered endpoints plus3 equally spaced in gamma or log-positive-coefficient interval spanning closest bracketing scout controls, retaining coefficient0 when needed. If still no bracket, preserve original grid and label coverage unresolved; no endless tuning. Record actual controls before main grid.
bounded_scout.launch_status: Disabled for current launch to preserve fixed grids and gamma2 checkpoint reuse. Retained as a pre-test future protocol option only; initial listed grids are final for launch. Failed L0 coverage is unresolved, not permission for post-test grid tuning.

selected_pilots.positive_controls: Pure ground-truth code/dictionary must score cosine1,mixing0,F1=1 by deterministic evaluator check. Known-D initialized BatchTopK K1.8/K2 training controls would be12 fits (2 K x2 signs x3 worlds); these are optional future preregistered diagnostics and are not required new launch arms. Failure to reproduce paper drift at the short budget is not a paper refutation.
selected_pilots.acceptance: Use common joint dictionary/support/leakage criterion at target1.8. Report L1, rescaled-L1, Gated, AnthropicJump, BatchTopK separately. Wrong-sparsity robustness requires prespecified1.8 AND2.2. Corr0 sanity is not a proof of no mixing.
selected_pilots.negative_route: If VG beats L1 coefficient metrics but not strong controls in dictionary/support, retain it as feasible L1 alternative and use P2/P3 to test added value; do not claim unique anti-mixing mechanism.
selected_pilots.reuse: P2 p.4 fixed-gamma2 and all common data; P1 intermediate/final checkpoints can support future preregistered analyses. Do not add no-variance/no-entropy module grid within this pilot; those are a focused later ablation after a promising full-VG regime exists.

selected_pilots.title: Minimal normalized scalar-prior adaptation without true L0
selected_pilots.question: Can the same VG automatically reach a useful operating region across densities without truth-based selection?

arms.fixed_source_recipe: gamma=2 chosen a priori, same profiled beta and native .5 readout
arms.primary_comparison: learned gamma initialized2 versus fixed gamma2; other initializations are mandatory sensitivity checks, not best-of-three selection

training.network_optimizer: Common Adam lr.003, matching root/P1 launch contract
training.gamma_optimizer: Separate Adam parameter group lr3e-3, same betas, initialized to stated gamma; clamp[-8,8] after update and log frequency. One fixed recipe, no post-test choice between gradient and alternating updates.
training.objective: Implement differentiable gamma*sum(m)+J*softplus(-gamma) in run-local loss; all other core terms and sample normalization unchanged. Do not pass tensor gamma through core float() conversion.

numerical_gates: Fixed-gamma local loss and network gradients equal current objective within float64 tolerance
Finite-difference gamma gradient at positive and negative gamma
No support, dictionary truth or true L0 enters gamma update or stopping
selected_pilots.selection: Final checkpoint of fixed init2 is main deployment arm. Report init-2 and init6 without selecting among them. P1 p.4 oracle-cal ceiling is an explicitly labeled reference only; no oracle ceiling is invented for untrained p.2/.6 grids.
selected_pilots.acceptance: At both target densities p.2 and p.6 and both rho signs, at least2/3 worlds show signed-cosine gain>=.05 OR recovered fraction>=.20, F1 gain>=.03 and mixing decrease>=.01 versus fixed gamma2; no source p.4 signed-cosine drop>.03. Across3 initializations signed-cosine range<=.05 and no substantial endpoint occupancy (>1% updates). These are demanding follow-up signals, not statistical proof.
selected_pilots.density_interpretation: Changing achieved L0 is the intended total effect of adaptation. Call a recovery gain operating-point selection benefit. Claim intrinsic lower mixing at matched L0 only where an independent fixed-gamma calibration grid supplies a pair within.10; p.2/.6 do not have that control in this bounded plan. Closeness of pi or expected L0 to true mean alone never passes.
selected_pilots.failure: Stable incorrect/mixed prior, strong initialization dependence, worse true support or dense/collapse endpoint is an informative failure. Clamp/precision-floor domination is numerical unresolved. Do not add per-feature or pairwise prior before recording this result.

selected_pilots.title: Exact32 joint support as a high-upside mechanism test
selected_pilots.question: Does removing the mean-field family restriction improve learned dictionary identity beyond removing amortization error?
arms: Current amortized mean-field VG at fixed beta10
Optimized product-Bernoulli mean-field VG at fixed beta10
Exact32 conditional-support VG at fixed beta10

training.decoder_init: Same random D per world/arm, same point-amplitude head initialization and minibatches; decoder bias shared recipe
training.beta_note: Fixed finite beta10 is a run-local controlled objective. Freeze beta explicitly; core only offers profiled/learned modes, so do not label a still-trained log_beta parameter fixed. This is not a direct causal comparison against P1 profiled runs.
training.objective: For each input and support s, E_s=beta/2*||x-b-D(s*a)||²+gamma*|s|. q_exact=softmax(-E_s); F_exact=-logsumexp(-E_s)+J*softplus(-gamma), up to common Gaussian normalizer. Keep point amplitude conditional; no full generative ELBO claim.
training.optimized_mean_field: Cyclic coordinate minimization from3 fixed starts(.1,.5,.9), choose lowest variational F; at most50 full sweeps, convergence max|delta m|<1e-5, check stationarity residual. Detach converged q for envelope-gradient training; report all failed batches and training cost. Where <95% batches meet tolerance, covariance conclusion is unresolved. A single local product optimum is not a global-MF certificate; report the3-start limitation.
training.exact_gradients: Use differentiable -logsumexp or mathematically equal envelope gradient. Verify equality numerically. Exact family retains covariance terms in risk; mean-field diagonal variance gradient alone is radial at fixed codes.

optimized_mean_field_detail.initialization_semantics: For each sample/minibatch solve3 separate product posteriors with all5 initial probabilities set to the stated constant. No ground-truth support, test tuning or amortized-head-only initialization.
optimized_mean_field_detail.coordinate_update: r_minus_j=x-b-sum_{k!=j} m_k*a_k*d_k; logit_j=beta*a_j*(d_j dot r_minus_j)-0.5*beta*a_j^2*||d_j||^2-gamma; m_j=sigmoid(logit_j). Use the newest coordinates in cyclic Gauss-Seidel order.
optimized_mean_field_detail.convergence: Require max across samples/latents |m_after_sweep-m_before_sweep|<1e-5 AND max|m-sigmoid(current coordinate logit)|<5e-5; log both residuals and per-start convergence. Strong beta saturation is not itself proof of stationarity.
optimized_mean_field_detail.winner: For each sample choose the lowest independently evaluated complete mean-field variational free energy among the3 terminal starts, ties by start index. Record winning start and whether it converged. This is a3-start local-MF control, not a globally certified optimum.
optimized_mean_field_detail.gradient: Detach selected solved m and differentiate complete expected quadratic risk plus Bernoulli entropy/prior with respect to D,a,b; use envelope interpretation only when converged. Amortized gate head route uses ordinary full backprop.
optimized_mean_field_detail.evaluation: Use the same3 starts/order/50-sweep cap/tolerances for calibration and test. No larger solver allowance only on the model that performs poorly.
optimized_mean_field_detail.numerical_unresolved: If fewer than95% training batches meet the chosen-convergence criteria or evaluation residuals fail, report exact-versus-MF attribution unresolved. Include all sample/seed solver-failure rates.

secondary_mixed_init.initialization: Oracle mechanism-only D_j=normalize(f_j+sign(rho)*.3*f_0) for j>0 and D_0=f_0. Shared amplitude initialization; label access to true D. Same3 arms x2 signs x3 worlds.
secondary_mixed_init.purpose: Test return from a prespecified mixed dictionary. Never replace random-init evidence or claim deployability. Drop entire secondary block before test access if runtime probe forecasts cap breach.

numerical_gates: Enumerated32 risk equals explicit state-weighted residual risk
For product q, exact moments agree with mean-risk+Bernoulli-variance formula
At orthogonal D with independent support prior, exact support posterior factorizes to numerical precision
Analytic coordinate stationary update and finite differences agree
Envelope gradients for exact and converged MF verified on tiny float64 example
selected_pilots.readout_and_selection: Native joint MAP primary for exact model; native optimized marginal>.5 for MF. Also evaluate exact marginal>.5 to expose readout effects. Final checkpoint primary; calibration-only target selection and pair-L0 tolerance apply within this fixed-beta grid. If the3-point grid cannot match L0, report same-gamma total effects and mark density-matched mechanism claim unresolved.
selected_pilots.acceptance: Exact joint must beat OPTIMIZED MF, not merely current head, by cosine>=.05 OR recovered fraction>=.20 plus F1>=.03 and mixing decrease>=.01 in>=2/3 worlds for each sign. Main evidence comes from random starts, with paired L0 difference<=.10. Dictionary improvement should persist under prespecified common marginal readout control; MAP-only support gains do not establish better training covariance mechanism. Mixed-init success is corroboration only.
selected_pilots.failure_and_routing: Exact joint equals/loses to converged MF: independent family is not shown to be limiting here. Optimized MF beats head while exact adds little: prioritize S05 amortized residual teacher. Only mixed-init gains: optimization feasibility, not robust end-to-end success. Exact gains without matched L0 or adequate MF convergence: unresolved attribution.
selected_pilots.scale_boundary: 32-state cost is exponential in width. Positive result authorizes a later bounded block posterior proposal and equal-compute controls; it does not itself supply a scalable SAE, semantic posterior or publication-level superiority claim.

resource_summary.unused_margin_note: Remaining margin is not permission for a fourth pilot or silent post-test expansion. Record all actual use, stop at route caps.

nonselection_is_not_rejection: Continuation, train-time teacher, precision control, feature-specific priors and explicit slabs remain bounded follow-up options under the stated evidence conditions. Do not add modules merely to answer reviewer objections.
implementation_handoff: Root owns integration and preregistration. Independent agents may implement P2/P3 run-local runners after this allocation. This jury edits only its evidence/trace outputs, runs no experiments and changes no canonical proposal/source.
